intro: Four pieces of siew mai are about 240 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the meat or prawn filling and the fat inside it.
diet: Yes. Siew mai is one of the higher-protein dim sum, and it's steamed, not fried. What matters is how many plates you take. Go for steamed items and limit the fried ones.
tips: Choose steamed items like siew mai and har gow, have less of the fried ones.
Order a plate of steamed veggies with a little oyster sauce.
Drink Chinese tea without sugar, not sweet drinks.

swap.name: Har gow, 4 pieces
swap.why: Leaner prawn filling and thin skin, so fewer calories.

faq.a: Traditional siew mai uses pork. Go to dim sum restaurants with halal certification, they use chicken and prawn.

faq.q: Can I steam frozen siew mai straight away?
faq.a: Yes. Steam for 8 to 12 minutes until the filling is fully cooked.

faq.q: What's the orange topping on siew mai?
faq.a: Usually fish roe or minced carrot, for colour and taste.
